verdict.rationale: Undermind documents reading full-text PDFs in parallel and answering questions across many papers (docs-5). It also offers curated paper folders (docs-7) and 'unlimited workspaces, files, and paper libraries' (docs-18), which suggests it can research over a user-held collection. However, none of the evidence says users can upload their own PDFs or corpus; the PDF reading appears to apply to papers Undermind itself finds. Missing for 10: explicit user PDF/corpus upload, documentation of running research restricted to an uploaded corpus, any hands-on corroboration.
